# commit-message-writer, stage 1: cases

The cases come first: `docs/evals.md` line 9 says nobody writes `SKILL.tmpl.md` until the cases have goldens and a baseline round without the skill has run.

## Cases

- 16 trigger cases: 8 that should load the skill and 8 near misses, 4 of each kind in the test split. The near misses include release notes (the `release-notes` skill) and the claims of a finished story (`claims-writer`, from the Skills table in `AGENTS.md`).
- 2 task cases, `staged-fix` and `long-subject`. Each item cites `CONTRIBUTING.md` in the case's own `world/`, or `format`.

## Files

- `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/staged-fix/case.json`
- `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/staged-fix/world/CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/staged-fix/world/README.md`
- `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/long-subject/case.json`
- `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/long-subject/world/CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/long-subject/world/README.md`
- the 16 trigger case folders under `evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/` (`staged-retry-fix` to `branch-name`), each with `case.json` and `world/README.md`

## Next

- Goldens: someone who did not write these cases (`docs/evals.md` line 34).
- Baseline round without the skill: the eval owner (`docs/evals.md` line 35).
- Then the template, once the baseline label is in `evals/results/`.

log.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os
load = [["I've staged the retry fix in client.go, write the commit message for it", "test"], ["the last commit just says wip, give me a real message to amend it with", "train"], ["tests pass now, commit this with a proper message", "test"], ["my commit subject runs to 94 characters, can you redo the message", "train"], ["write the commit message for dropping the session cache, and say why we dropped it", "test"], ["turn 'fixed login bug and some tests' into a proper commit message", "train"], ["I split this into two commits, write a message for each", "test"], ["here's the diff for the rate limiter, what should the commit say?", "train"]]
miss = [["write the release notes for v4.2.0 from the merged pull requests", "test"], ["story S-12 is finished, write its claims for the story judge", "test"], ["add a CHANGELOG.md line for the new --export flag", "train"], ["rebase my branch onto main and sort out the conflicts", "test"], ["review the diff on this branch before I commit it", "train"], ["set up commitlint so a bad commit message fails the build", "train"], ["summarise git log since Monday for my standup", "test"], ["suggest a branch name for the retry work", "train"]]
index = {"file": "AGENTS.md", "after": "| Name | When to use | File |", "row": "| {name} | {description} | [{path}]({path}) |"}
readme = "# Payments service\n\nA small Go service. Changes reach main through reviewed pull requests.\n"
names = ["staged-retry-fix", "amend-wip", "commit-after-green", "subject-too-long", "why-in-body", "past-tense-subject", "two-commits", "message-for-diff", "notes-for-tag", "claims-for-story", "changelog-entry", "rebase-branch", "review-diff", "commitlint-ci", "standup-log", "branch-name"]
for n, (prompt, split, should) in enumerate([(p, s, True) for p, s in load] + [(p, s, False) for p, s in miss], 1):
    d = 'evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/' + names[n - 1]
    os.makedirs(d + '/world', exist_ok=True)
    open(d + '/world/README.md', 'w').write(readme)
    case = {'kind': 'trigger', 'prompt': prompt, 'should_trigger': should, 'split': split, 'index': index}
    open(d + '/case.json', 'w').write(json.dumps(case, indent=2) + '\n')
EOF
